title: Allow reading secret values
subtitle: Values are decrypted on the Coolify server and sealed for your hub. Plain text never travels.

consent.typeHost: Type the Coolify server name to allow it
consent.neverRead: Never read: the Coolify encryption key, its own passwords and the SSH private keys.
consent.title: Allow reading secret values
consent.summary: These are decrypted on {host} and sealed for your hub. Plain text never travels. Without this, apps and databases cannot be imported.
consent.typeHostHint: Typing the name tells Tugra you read what you are allowing.
consent.t2Note: Notification tokens, Git app keys and deploy keys are off unless you tick them. Deploy keys are better created again in Tugra.
consent.ownerOnly: Only an owner of the team can allow this.
consent.ownerOnlyWhy: Ask an owner of {team} to run this move: it needs their permission to read secret values.
consent.notUsed: Not read by the import yet
consent.ended: This permission ended: it was withdrawn, another owner allowed it for a different import, or its time ran out. Allow it again to continue.
consent.missingNote: Without {classes}, apps and databases are created without those values and you add them by hand afterwards.
consent.endsWithImport: This permission ends when the import is finished, when this connection ends (it lasts one hour) or when you stop it.
consent.skipped: Secret values are not allowed yet. Apps and databases cannot be imported until you allow them.
consent.applyNeeded: Allow reading secret values below before you apply. Without it nothing can be imported.

unreadable.title: Values that could not be read
unreadable.hint: Only these items are held back. The rest continues.

wire.bad_mac: The value failed its integrity check.
wire.bad_payload: The stored value has an unexpected format.
wire.no_key: The Coolify key could not be read.
wire.key_prev: Opened with a previous Coolify key.
wire.unsupported_cipher: The Coolify cipher is not supported.
wire.unsupported_serialization: The stored value has an unsupported format.
wire.column_missing: This Coolify version does not have that field.

error.agent_offline: The agent on the Coolify server is offline. Try again when it is back.
error.agent_too_old: This server's agent is too old for this. Update the agent first.
error.grant_active: Another consent with different choices is active on this server. Stop it first.
error.forbidden: Only an owner of the team can allow this.
error.name_mismatch: The name does not match the Coolify server.
error.expired: This import session has ended. Connect again.
error.consent_required: Secret values are not allowed for this import (the consent was not given, has run out or ended). Allow it again to apply.

standing.title: Secret values are allowed for this import
